news.title: Bitcoin plunges below $66,000 as global stocks, AI trades hit fresh records
news.summary: BTC plunged 6.4% to a 24-hour low of $65,708 and ether broke below $1,900 in Asian trading on Wednesday, just hours after the MSCI All Country World Index set a fresh all-time high on the AI rally.

news.title: Mastercard expands on-chain settlement in bet on stablecoins and always-on finance
news.summary: The company plans to offer stablecoin, weekend and holiday settlement as demand grows for real-time movement of money.

news.title: Bitcoin's slide to $66,000 is accelerating a shift into digital dollars
news.summary: The crypto market is seeing a capital flight into dollar-linked stablecoins even as stocks and the Dollar Index remain calm.
